key_patterns: All components: functional React + TypeScript prop interfaces. Tailwind only — no custom CSS except src/index.css. Brand tokens in tailwind.config.js: navy=#000F33, brand_red=#EC1C24, gold=#D4AF37, cream=#F8F4EF, dark=#222222. Supabase singleton: src/lib/supabase.ts — all pages import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase'. Page loading pattern: useState(true) for loading, useState(null) for error, cleanup with cancelled flag, useEffect. Modal pattern: fixed overlay, controlled boolean + onClose. Status filter pills: 'All' + status values, active pill = bg-navy text-cream. Table pattern: bg-white rounded-xl shadow overflow-hidden, thead bg-gray-50, divide-y divide-gray-100. Button primary: bg-brand_red text-cream hover:bg-red-700. Button secondary: border border-gray-300 text-dark hover:bg-gray-50. Input class: border border-gray-300 rounded px-3 py-2 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-navy. Error display: text-brand_red bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded px-3 py-2.
